title: Manoeuvres
html:
Manoeuvres are a set of passive features available to Battle Master Fighter at Level 3 or those who have taken the  Martial Adept feat. They are powerful attacks that use  Superiority Die, a resource that recovers on a Short Rest or Long Rest.

Save DC

  • If the manoeuvre requires a save DC, that DC is 8 + your Proficiency Modifier + your Strength or Dexterity modifier, whichever is higher.

List of manoeuvres

Manoeuvres Description Grants Save
Commander's Strike Expend one attack from your attack action and a bonus action to direct an ally to strike a foe. The ally uses their reaction to make a weapon attack on their turn. Commander's Strike
Disarming Attack Spend a superiority die to make an attack that deals an additional 1d8 damage and possibly forces the target to drop the weapons they are holding. Disarming Attack (Melee)

Disarming Attack (Ranged)

 STR Save
Distracting Strike  Distract your target, giving your allies Advantage on their next Attack Roll against the target. Distracting Strike (Melee)

Distracting Strike (Ranged)

Evasive Footwork You can evade attacks by imposing Disadvantage on melee attacks against you for a round. Evasive Footwork
Feinting Attack Use both your action and bonus action on a turn to attack a target with Advantage and deal an additional 1d8 damage. Feinting Attack
Goading Attack Deal an additional 1d8 and attempt to goad the target attacking you. Target receives Disadvantage on attacking any other creature. Goading Attack (Melee)

Goading Attack (Ranged)

 WIS Save
Manoeuvring Attack Spend a superiority die to make an attack that deals an additional 1d8 damage. On a hit, select which friendly creature will gain half its movement speed. It will not provoke attacks of opportunity. Manoeuvring Attack (Melee)

Manoeuvring Attack (Ranged)

Menacing Attack Spend a superiority die to make an attack that deals an additional 1d8 damage and possibly Frightens the target. Menacing Attack (Melee)

Menacing Attack (Ranged)

 WIS Save
Precision Attack Spend a Superiority Die and add its result to an Attack Roll. Precision Attack
Pushing Attack Spend a superiority die to make an attack that deals an additional 1d8 damage and possibly pushes the target back 4.5 m (15 ft). Pushing Attack (Melee)

Pushing Attack (Ranged)

 STR Save
Rally Expend a superiority die to grant an ally 8 temporary hit points, bolstering their resolve. Rally
Riposte When a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, expend a superiority die to retaliate with a powerful attack that deals an additional 1d8 damage. Riposte
Sweeping Attack Swing your weapon in a rapid, sweeping arc to attack multiple enemies at once. Roll your superiority die for damage. Sweeping Attack
Trip Attack Spend a superiority die to make an attack that deals an additional 1d8 damage and possibly knocks the target  Prone.
The target must be Large or smaller. 		Trip Attack (Melee)

Trip Attack (Ranged)

 STR Save

Other sources of manoeuvres

Some items have Manoeuvres as special weapon actions. These do not cost  Superiority Dice.

  • Bonespike Helmet - Menacing Attack (Melee)
  • Ravengard's Scourger, Duke Ravengard's Longsword - Commander's Strike
  • Titanstring Bow - Pushing Attack (Ranged)

Things that affect manoeuvres

  • Gauntlets of the Warmaster
